assumptions.choice: Evaluate 2% stop loss trigger against bar low for long positions (low <= entry_price * 0.98) and bar high for short positions (high >= entry_price * 1.02).
assumptions.reason: Intraday bar low and high represent the extreme prices reached during the 5-minute bar to detect if the stop loss threshold was touched.

assumptions.choice: On an opposite MACD crossover, issue self.close() to exit the current position and self.sell()/self.buy() to enter the reverse position on the same bar.
assumptions.reason: An opposite crossover serves simultaneously as the exit signal for the current position and the entry signal for the new direction.

assumptions.choice: Use default market orders executed on the open of the subsequent bar for all entries and exits.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define specific order types or execution mechanics.
